fieldValues.outro: A Field Group entry does not have its own `instanceId`, lifecycle state, or Relation endpoints. If a group entry will ever need to be referenced independently, related to other Records, or reused across multiple Records, it should be a separate Record connected by a `contains` or `derived-from` Relation.

cells: Multiple values of the same type, no pairing needed
Multiple structured entries that must be read together
Repeated items need their own identity, lifecycle, or reuse
